+### Mining on Kaggle
+
+The same mining on two T4s, when the local GPU is busy: the prompts are built
+here, without a GPU, and only the sampling runs there. `kaggle_mine_bundle.py`
+splits the inputs into shards (every Nth input to each), pins what the
+notebook downloads (llama.cpp's CUDA 12.8 build by SHA-256, the models by the
+revision and SHA-256 of `src/models/registry.rs`) and orders the jobs, a model
+and a shard each, the longest first.
+
+The inputs of the second run are mostly Conventional (the first had 7%), from
+`data/train-all` without the commits the SFT trained on (`data/curve`) and
+without the evaluation sets' repositories, at most 8 commits per repository
+and 22% of a type (young repositories apart):
+
+```bash
+EX="--exclude-hashes-of data/curve --exclude-repos-of data/eval-v1 data/eval-short data/val1"
+$SCT select data/train-all data/dpo2/conv  --conventional 4500 --free 0 --per-repo 8 \
+  --max-type-share 0.22 --supported-only $EX
+$SCT select data/train-all data/dpo2/young --conventional 1000 --free 0 --per-repo 3 \
+  --min-history 0 --max-history 9 --max-type-share 0.3 --supported-only $EX
+mkdir -p data/dpo2/mix
+cat data/dpo2/conv/inputs.jsonl data/dpo2/young/inputs.jsonl > data/dpo2/mix/inputs.jsonl
+cat data/dpo2/conv/meta.jsonl   data/dpo2/young/meta.jsonl   > data/dpo2/mix/meta.jsonl
+python -I mine_pairs.py data/dpo2/mix data/dpo2/mine --binary $SC --prompts-only \
+  --rules full --diff plain --exclude-repos-of data/eval-v1 data/eval-short data/val1
+python -I kaggle_mine_bundle.py data/kaggle/dpo2-mine data/dpo2/mine --samples 6
+# upload it as a private dataset, run kaggle_mine.ipynb on it with GPU T4 x2 and internet,
+# download the <model>-shard-K.tar.gz archives and unpack them in data/dpo2/mined/.
+# A shard's candidates line up with that shard's inputs, so the pairs are made per
+# shard, with the shard's directory of the bundle, and concatenated:
+for size in 0.5b 1.5b; do
+  for k in 0 1 2 3; do
+    $SCT pairs data/dpo2/mined/$size-shard-$k/candidates.jsonl data/kaggle/dpo2-mine/shard-$k \
+      data/dpo2/pairs-$size-$k.jsonl
+  done
+  cat data/dpo2/pairs-$size-?.jsonl > data/dpo2/pairs-$size.jsonl
+done
+```
+
+The notebook checks each download against its SHA-256, samples four inputs of
+each model first (so a CUDA build that does not fit the image fails in a
+minute, not after an hour), and packs a job as soon as it ends.
+

+"""Packs a mining run for the Kaggle notebook (kaggle_mine.ipynb) into one
+directory, to upload as a private Kaggle dataset.
+
+    python -I kaggle_mine_bundle.py OUT_DIR SRC_DIR [--shards N] [--samples K] [--seed S] [MODEL ...]
+
+SRC_DIR is what `mine_pairs.py --prompts-only` wrote: `inputs.jsonl`,
+`meta.jsonl` and `prompts.jsonl`. The inputs go into N shards, every Nth
+input to each, so a shard that does not finish leaves the others
+representative; each MODEL (`0.5b`, `1.5b`) samples every shard, a job per
+pair, the longest first. The bundle holds mine_pairs.py, the shards,
+and `runs.json` with what the notebook downloads, pinned: llama.cpp's CUDA
+build by SHA-256, the models by the revision and SHA-256 of
+`src/models/registry.rs`.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import re
+import shutil
+from pathlib import Path
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).parent
+USER = "lucasbrt"  # Kaggle username
+REGISTRY = HERE.parent / "src/models/registry.rs"
+# The CUDA 12.8 build Kaggle's T4 driver runs, and the runtime libraries it needs.
+LLAMA = {
+    "release": "b11381",
+    "assets": [
+        {"name": "llama-b11381-bin-ubuntu-cuda-12.8-x64.tar.gz",
+         "sha256": "86805e29e1277297334d20bcb2a75cd6d921d0b8fcc22d521d5c3961f3990fbb"},
+        {"name": "cudart-llama-b11381-bin-ubuntu-cuda-12.8-x64.tar.gz",
+         "sha256": "13c6d5079689e8c0bc90fc4b89188a5d9777cc2f362398f3376fd4c8d5c3c044"},
+    ],
+    "url": "https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/download/{release}/{name}",
+}
+# Seconds a job takes per input and sample on a T4, to put the longest first.
+COST = {"0.5b": 1, "1.5b": 2.2}
+
+
+def models(registry: str) -> dict[str, dict]:
+    """The v0.1 models of the registry: repo, revision, file, size, sha256."""
+    found = {}
+    for block in registry.split("Model {")[1:]:
+        fields = dict(re.findall(r'\b(id|repo|revision|file|sha256): "([^"]*)"', block))
+        size = re.search(r"size: ([\d_]+)", block)
+        if fields.get("id", "").startswith("smart-commit-") and size:
+            key = fields["id"].split("-")[2]
+            found[key] = {"repo": fields["repo"], "revision": fields["revision"],
+                          "file": fields["file"], "size": int(size[1].replace("_", "")),
+                          "sha256": fields["sha256"]}
+    return found
+
+
+def shards(src: Path, out: Path, count: int) -> list[dict]:
+    """Writes `shard-K` for K in 0..count: every count-th line of the three files."""
+    files = {name: (src / f"{name}.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()
+             for name in ("inputs", "meta", "prompts")}
+    sizes = {len(lines) for lines in files.values()}
+    if len(sizes) != 1:
+        raise SystemExit(f"{src}: inputs, meta and prompts must have the same number of lines")
+    written = []
+    for k in range(count):
+        directory = out / f"shard-{k}"
+        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        for name, lines in files.items():
+            (directory / f"{name}.jsonl").write_text("".join(f"{line}\n" for line in lines[k::count]))
+        written.append({"dir": directory.name, "inputs": len(files["inputs"][k::count]),
+                        "sha256": hashlib.sha256((directory / "prompts.jsonl").read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
+    return written
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("out", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("src", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--shards", type=int, default=4)
+    parser.add_argument("--samples", type=int, default=6)
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
+    parser.add_argument("models", nargs="*", default=["0.5b", "1.5b"])
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    pinned = models(REGISTRY.read_text())
+    unknown = [m for m in args.models if m not in pinned]
+    if unknown:
+        parser.error(f"not in the registry: {unknown}; it has {sorted(pinned)}")
+    args.out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    shutil.copy(HERE / "mine_pairs.py", args.out / "mine_pairs.py")
+    parts = shards(args.src, args.out, args.shards)
+    jobs = [{"name": f"{model}-{part['dir']}", "model": model, "shard": part["dir"],
+             "inputs": part["inputs"], "prompts_sha256": part["sha256"]}
+            for model in args.models for part in parts]
+    jobs.sort(key=lambda j: -j["inputs"] * COST[j["model"]])
+    (args.out / "runs.json").write_text(json.dumps({
+        "llama": LLAMA,
+        "models": {m: pinned[m] for m in args.models},
+        "sampling": {"rules": "full", "diff": "plain", "samples": args.samples,
+                     "temperature": 0.7, "top_p": 0.95, "seed": args.seed, "workers": 4},
+        "jobs": jobs,
+    }, indent=2) + "\n")
+    (args.out / "dataset-metadata.json").write_text(json.dumps({
+        "title": f"smart-commit-training-{args.out.name}",
+        "id": f"{USER}/smart-commit-training-{args.out.name}",
+        "licenses": [{"name": "other"}],
+    }, indent=2) + "\n")
+    for job in jobs:
+        print(f"{job['name']}: {job['inputs']} inputs")
+    print(f"upload {args.out} as a private Kaggle dataset")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Checks the bundle of the Kaggle mining run.
+
+    python -I test_kaggle_mine_bundle.py
+"""
+
+import json
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).parent
+sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
+from kaggle_mine_bundle import LLAMA, REGISTRY, models, shards  # noqa: E402
+
+
+def write_src(d: Path, count: int) -> None:
+    d.mkdir()
+    for name in ("inputs", "meta", "prompts"):
+        (d / f"{name}.jsonl").write_text("".join(json.dumps({name: n}) + "\n" for n in range(count)))
+
+
+def test_the_models_are_those_of_the_registry() -> None:
+    pinned = models(REGISTRY.read_text())
+    assert sorted(pinned) == ["0.5b", "1.5b"]
+    for key, model in pinned.items():
+        assert model["repo"] == f"LucasBRT/smart-commit-{key}-v0.1"
+        assert model["file"] == f"smart-commit-{key}-v0.1-q4_k_m.gguf"
+        assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", model["revision"])
+        assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", model["sha256"]) and model["size"] > 10**8
+
+
+def test_every_nth_input_goes_to_each_shard() -> None:
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
+        d = Path(tmp)
+        write_src(d / "src", 10)
+        parts = shards(d / "src", d / "out", 3)
+        assert [p["inputs"] for p in parts] == [4, 3, 3]
+        for k in range(3):
+            for name in ("inputs", "meta", "prompts"):
+                rows = [json.loads(line)[name] for line in (d / f"out/shard-{k}/{name}.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
+                assert rows == list(range(k, 10, 3))
+        # A source whose files disagree is refused.
+        (d / "src/meta.jsonl").write_text("{}\n")
+        try:
+            shards(d / "src", d / "bad", 2)
+        except SystemExit as e:
+            assert "same number of lines" in str(e)
+        else:
+            raise AssertionError("files of different lengths were accepted")
+
+
+def test_the_longest_jobs_come_first_and_everything_is_pinned() -> None:
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
+        d = Path(tmp)
+        write_src(d / "src", 9)
+        subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", str(HERE / "kaggle_mine_bundle.py"), str(d / "bundle"),
+                        str(d / "src"), "--shards", "3", "--samples", "5"], check=True, capture_output=True)
+        spec = json.loads((d / "bundle/runs.json").read_text())
+        assert [j["name"] for j in spec["jobs"]] == [f"{m}-shard-{k}" for m in ("1.5b", "0.5b") for k in range(3)]
+        assert spec["sampling"]["samples"] == 5 and spec["sampling"]["rules"] == "full"
+        assert all(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", a["sha256"]) for a in spec["llama"]["assets"])
+        assert spec["llama"] == LLAMA
+        for name in ("mine_pairs.py", "dataset-metadata.json", "shard-0/prompts.jsonl"):
+            assert (d / "bundle" / name).exists(), name
+        # One model only.
+        subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", str(HERE / "kaggle_mine_bundle.py"), str(d / "one"),
+                        str(d / "src"), "0.5b"], check=True, capture_output=True)
+        assert {j["model"] for j in json.loads((d / "one/runs.json").read_text())["jobs"]} == {"0.5b"}
+        refused = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", str(HERE / "kaggle_mine_bundle.py"), str(d / "x"),
+                                  str(d / "src"), "7b"], capture_output=True, text=True)
+        assert refused.returncode != 0 and "not in the registry" in refused.stderr
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    for name, fn in list(globals().items()):
+        if name.startswith("test_"):
+            fn()
+            print("ok", name)
